data.label: include
data.reason_zh: RBC以随机实验评估并筛选可复用playbook经验，将优选playbook用于新任务，属方法型RSI。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Random inclusion makes tasks with and without a block comparable, so the gap in their success estimates the block's effect.
scope_support.object_quote: We propose Randomized Block Curation (RBC), which measures this effect with a randomized experiment on practice tasks.
scope_support.persistence_quote: grows several and serves whichever curated, whole or no playbook scores best on fresh practice episodes.
